text: dsh-control-hub 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件总控台，通过 DSH bundle 向会话注册三个工具。它能列出当前 profile 声明的插件包、版本和磁盘存在状态，也能检查 profile 清单、技能目录及配置的本地服务是否可用；输入任务描述后，还会根据随包维护的路由表匹配插件、入口和可用状态。适合需要盘点 DSH 安装、排查插件状态或从已有工具中查找任务入口的用户。实现读取本地 profile 与技能目录，并可探测本机服务端口；代码未读取 API 密钥，也未配置外部服务。

dsh-control-hub adds three tools to DeepSeek Harness. It lists profile plugins and their disk status, checks the skills folder and local services, and matches tasks to routing-table entries. It reads local files and probes local services; no API key is configured.
我想快速盘点当前 DSH profile 里装了哪些插件和技能。
能不能按我描述的任务，查出应该用哪个插件并显示它是否可用？
I need to check whether my DSH profile, skills folder, and configured local services are available.
dsh-control-hub 的「插件与技能清单」功能：列出当前 profile 中声明的 bundle、版本和磁盘存在状态，并列出技能目录项目。会话工具自动读取当前 profile，也可指定另一个 profile。
dsh-control-hub feature “Task routing”: send a task description to hub_route to find matching plugins and entry points.

dsh-control-hub README · dsh-plugin-hub：[](https://github.com/Charles950311/dsh-plugin-hub/actions/workflows/test.yml) **One control hub for every plugin and skill installed in DeepSeek Harness (dsh).**

dsh-control-hub README · dsh-plugin-hub：DeepSeek Harness ships a deliberately barebones core — "everything is a plugin".
Within weeks its community produced turn rewind, long-term memory, skill cards,
failure-experience libraries, Obsidian bridges, browser automation, local
transcription, security scanners... and then you face the real problem:

> You have 7 plugins across profile bundles, a skills directory, and built-in
> tools. You can't remember which one does what, whether it's actually running,
> or what you installed last week.

dsh-control-hub README · dsh-plugin-hub：- **One routing table** (`SKILL.md`) — the agent answers "which tool for X" from a
  single, maintained table instead of guessing across plugin lists.
- **One status command** (`status.ps1`) — profile plugins, tool files, services,
  and skill junctions, checked in one shot.
- **One install step** (`install.ps1`) — copies the hub and junctions it into
  `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills` so DSH hot-loads it. Skills stay in one unified
  directory; no more copy-pasting folders into `.dsh`.
- **One manifest** (`PROVENANCE.md`) — what you installed, from where, which
  license, verified how. The routing table is only allowed to claim what this
  file confirms.
- **Safety rules baked in** — third-party skills are untrusted by default; scan
  before install; no safety-policy-bypassing or account-pool plugins.

dsh-control-hub README · Two ways to run it：**1. As a dsh bundle (recommended).** The repo is an installable DeepSeek
Harness bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle`, and `cordis.patch.yml`
registers the plugin. Installing it adds three tools to the session:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Charles950311/dsh-plugin-hub
```

dsh-control-hub README · Two ways to run it：| Tool | Answers |
| --- | --- |
| `hub_plugins` | what is installed in this profile, which version, and whether each bundle is actually present on disk |
| `hub_check` | PASS/WARN/FAIL per check — profile manifest, third-party bundles on disk, skills directory, local services — each with a fix hint |
| `hub_route` | "which plugin handles X", from a maintained routing table, including whether that plugin is installed |

dsh-control-hub README · Two ways to run it：All three are read-only: nothing is installed, removed or patched. Platform
bundles (`@deepseek-ai/*`) are reported as `BUILTIN` — they ship inside the
harness, so a missing `node_modules` copy is normal, not a fault.

The npm name is `dsh-control-hub` (`dsh-plugin-hub` was already taken on npm);
the GitHub repo keeps the original name.

dsh-control-hub README · Two ways to run it：**2. As a skill + CLI scripts.** The original layout still works and needs no
Node: `install.ps1` copies the hub skill and junctions it into
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills`; `status.ps1` / `doctor.ps1` /
`gen-provenance.ps1` run outside the harness. See Quick start below.

dsh-control-hub README · Health checks：`status.ps1` gives you the inventory; `doctor.ps1` gives you a verdict per check with a fix hint, and `-Fix` applies the safe repairs (UTF-8 BOM, missing junction):

``` [PASS] config.ps1 present, UTF-8 BOM ok [PASS] junction points here [WARN] hindsight DOWN on port 8888 memory tools will fake-fail; start the service, then re-check.

dsh-control-hub README · Health checks：That WARN is the point: a loaded plugin is not a running service, and the hub
says so instead of letting a call fake-succeed.

dsh-control-hub README · What it does NOT do：- It is not a plugin manager (`dsh plugin add/remove` still does that) — it is
  the discovery, dispatch, and truth-keeping layer above your plugins.
- It does not collect or send anything anywhere. All paths come from your local
  `config.ps1`, which is git-ignored.

dsh-control-hub README · dsh-plugin-hub(DSH 插件总控台)：**DeepSeek Harness(dsh)里所有插件与技能的统一入口。**

DSH 内核刻意做得很薄——"Everything is a Plugin"。几周内社区就产出了对话回退、 长期记忆、技能卡片、失败经验库、Obsidian 桥、浏览器自动化、本地转写、安全扫描…… 然后你会遇到真正的问题: > 7 个插件散落在 profile bundles、技能目录和内置工具里。你记不清哪个干哪件事、 > 哪个现在真的可用、上周到底装过什么。 `dsh-plugin-hub` 就是缺的那个前门:

dsh-control-hub README · dsh-plugin-hub(DSH 插件总控台)：- **一张触发路由表**(`SKILL.md`)——Agent 回答"X 该用哪个工具"不再靠猜,查一张
  持续维护的表。
- **一条状态命令**(`status.ps1`)——profile 插件、工具文件、服务、技能 Junction
  一次体检。
- **一步安装**(`install.ps1`)——复制 hub 并 Junction 进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills`,
  DSH 热加载;技能统一放一个目录,不再往 `.dsh` 里拷文件夹。
- **一份装机清单**(`PROVENANCE.md`)——装了什么、来自哪、什么许可证、怎么验证的。
  路由表只允许声称这份清单确认过的东西。
- **内置安全规则**——第三方技能默认不可信;装前扫描;不装绕过安全策略和
  账号池类插件。

dsh-control-hub README · 两种用法：**1. 作为 dsh bundle(推荐)。** 本仓库现在就是可安装的 DeepSeek Harness bundle:
`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`,`cordis.patch.yml` 注册插件。装完会话里多三个工具:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Charles950311/dsh-plugin-hub
```

| 工具 | 回答什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `hub_plugins` | 这个 profile 里装了什么、什么版本、每个 bundle 是否真的在磁盘上 |
| `hub_check` | 逐项 PASS/WARN/FAIL:profile 清单、第三方 bundle、技能目录、本地服务,每项带修复提示 |
| `hub_route` | "X 该用哪个插件",来自持续维护的路由表,并标明该插件是否已安装 |

dsh-control-hub README · 两种用法：三个工具全部**只读**:不安装、不卸载、不打补丁。平台内置包(`@deepseek-ai/*`)标为
`BUILTIN`——它们随 harness 一起发布,`node_modules` 里没有副本是正常的,不是故障。

npm 包名是 `dsh-control-hub`(npm 上 `dsh-plugin-hub` 已被占用),GitHub 仓库保留原名。
